name: Blake Bailey
source: "I don't go on the apps often, so this is new to me, that doesn't mean you have to be nice about it. I have an intense lifestyle and a busy schedule, but I can always open a spot for someone who is worth my while. Swipe for a wild ride, no strings attached"
